_how: Subscribe-prompt pose + camera library (Xavier 2026-11-27 23:01). Each entry = one pose AND the camera that goes with it. The character is NOT always Jaden: each video uses its own lore character + a backdrop from that video. New entries: Xavier sends pose-editor code + a screenshot of the framing; add it here with the camera solved to match the screenshot. Default = the entry named in 'current'.

selfie_wave_v1.from: Lucky Me (2026-11-27), Jaden in front of his burning car
selfie_wave_v1.anim: free hand (armL) loose yo/sup wave: k=sin(t*7.5), k2=sin(t*7.5+.7); armL.r = [-1.596-.25*k2, -0.38+.15*k, -1.234+.42*k]

camera.handheld: sin wobble amplitude .01 on p.x / p.y / look.x
camera.note: camera just past his raised right hand (the phone), looking down at him

selfie_wave_v1.line: subscribe for more you guys (recorded line, lip-synced with talk())
selfie_wave_v1.ui: subscribe card via tools/captions_v2.py + topics/<t>/subscribe_ui.json {in,tap,out}; avatar library/brand/channel_avatar.jpg overlaid by tools/finalize.sh

rackfocus_crier_v1.from: New Body (2026-11-28). In-story ending used as the subscribe prompt; added as a new version, selfie_wave_v1 stays the default.
rackfocus_crier_v1.pose: TO POSE: swapped character (Dana's body, him inside) standing close to camera, smug, talking to lens; the victim (his old body, Dana inside) on the floor behind, curled up, crying with shoulder shakes.

camera.setup: medium close on the talker, 35-40 fov, victim 2.5-3.5 m behind and visible over her shoulder
camera.focus: DOF on talker for the line, then rack focus to the victim over ~0.6 s when the line ends; talker goes soft

rackfocus_crier_v1.line: Be a good boy, and subscribe.
